about: Every asset in SCION 42 film; nothing fetched from the web, no generated images, no Quick, Draw! drawings, no archive-door frames used.

assets.what: frames of a real dog (384x288, 12 fps), the only source of the dog on screen
assets.operation: mask (kit SAM polygons, largest component), few-shot layer discovery (EM + gradient descent, numpy/scipy), per-layer affine motion fit, splat rendering with dusk/door-light tint; turn frames cut out whole with the SAM mask and scaled
rasterised; distance transform and coverage targets for the fit; alpha of the turn views

assets.what: hand-placed rig keys (nose, neck, chest, tail, feet)
assets.operation: used only (a) to name the learned parts (head, foreleg, hind, tail) and (b) to build the authored-rig control the learned layers are compared with; facing of turn views measured from its nose key; never used to define the learned parts

assets.what: the trained puppet: template points, layer labels/weights, per-frame per-layer affines, hinges, tree
per-layer affines re-fitted to source frames 0-13 and 40-46
learned-layer and hand-cut-rig fits of archive turning frames 14-21, 26-33
assets.operation: computed by build/turn_fit.py; compared with best hand-set hinge poses in build/hinge_control.py

assets.what: PAELEO threshold score (dog decision trace, person, door, timeline)
house cut-away, stone wall and sill, door leaf, porch boards, dusk sky, tree-line, door light
coat silhouette person, authored layered rig (forward kinematics)
crickets, room tone, formant-synthesized voice, door latch and hinge, light hum, steps, stool, dog pads/claws, settle thumps, sigh
